subject.title: fix(github-copilot): bound Copilot token exchange fetch timeout

question: Should the shared Copilot token exchange adopt the existing 30-second OAuth request deadline even though unusually slow enterprise or proxied exchanges will now fail closed?
rationale: The implementation is correct and internally consistent, but selecting a fixed provider deadline is an intentional compatibility tradeoff that source inspection and loopback proof cannot fully settle for supported enterprise deployments.

options.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
options.body: Use the established Copilot OAuth timeout for this exchange and merge the revised internal-only implementation.

options.title: Request provider-specific calibration
options.body: Hold the PR until provider owners supply evidence for a different shared deadline or retry policy for supported enterprise endpoints.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Use the established Copilot OAuth timeout for this exchange and merge the revised internal-only implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the centralized exchange and the sibling Copilot timeout policy in the current implementation commit.
